posts.title: Brick phone blonde — cutout
posts.content:
## Result

Blonde with vintage brick phone cut out from blue background (transparent). Original kept as resource.

## Notes

- Soft hair edges — check against dark Pulse plates.
- Good 80s/90s flex plate for HEX / RH comps.
